system_overview: Three-tier monolith: Next.js 14 App Router frontend → FastAPI REST backend → PostgreSQL 16. Backend is layered as presentation (routers) / application (services) / domain (pure functions: stock calculations, carry-forward) / infrastructure (SQLAlchemy repositories + Alembic migrations). All transactional writes (Inward, Sales, Adjustment) and their resulting stock ledger updates run in a single SQLAlchemy database transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE locks on the affected ledger rows. The Sales Report and Stock Dashboard read from a materialised stock_ledger table that stores the running balance per (design, grade, txn_date); month-end carry-forward is implemented as a deterministic lookup of the previous month's last-day closing balance rather than a scheduled job. No authentication in V1 — all endpoints are open; deployment is via Docker images intended for a trusted internal network.

modules.name: Master Data Management
modules.responsibility: CRUD admin operations for all 6 master tables (Supplier, Staff, Dealer, Grade, Trading Size-Design, Design-Grade combinations) with soft-delete via is_active. Serves active-only dropdown feeds to all transaction forms and reports.
interfaces: GET /designs/{id}/grades — returns active mappings for a design

modules.name: Transaction Forms
modules.responsibility: Persistence of Inward, Sales, and Adjustment forms — header + lines in a single DB transaction. Validates date bounds (today and 7 days prior), enforces RULE-005 / RULE-006 / RULE-017 row skipping, and dispatches stock ledger updates as part of the same transaction.

modules.name: Stock Ledger
modules.responsibility: Maintains the canonical stock_ledger materialised table per (design_id, grade_id, txn_date) and exposes the running closing balance as of any date. Implements monthly carry-forward via FORMULA-002 (no scheduled job — lookup of last day of previous month). All ledger writes use SELECT FOR UPDATE on (design_id, grade_id) to serialize concurrent writes.

modules.name: Stock Dashboard
modules.responsibility: Read-only aggregation of Opening / Inward / Outward / Adjust / Closing per (active design, active grade) as of a selected date. Pure read path against tbl_inward_lines, tbl_sales_lines, tbl_adjustment_lines, and the stock_ledger.

modules.name: Sales Reporting
modules.responsibility: Computes Consolidation (GROUP BY design_id, grade_id) and Transaction (per-line) views from sales tables with multi-select optional filters: date range, dealer, place, design. Returns both sections in a single response payload for simultaneous render.

modules.name: Frontend Application
modules.responsibility: Next.js 14 App Router SPA. Renders Master admin pages, Inward / Sales / Adjustment forms with reactive grade-row auto-population on design change, Stock Dashboard, and Sales Report dual-pane layout. Talks to backend via a typed fetch client.

modules.name: Persistence & Migrations
modules.responsibility: SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models + Alembic migrations defining all 13 tables (6 masters + 6 transaction tables + 1 stock_ledger). Seed data scripts for grades, designs, suppliers, dealers, staff per the sample PRD.

risks.description: Concurrent saves on the same (design_id, grade_id) ledger row can race and produce wrong closing balances.
risks.mitigation: All stock ledger writes acquire SELECT FOR UPDATE on the latest row for (design_id, grade_id) before computing the new running balance. Documented as DS-002.

risks.description: Stock Dashboard live SUM over inward/sales/adjust per (design, grade) becomes slow as transaction volume grows.
risks.mitigation: Use the materialised stock_ledger running-balance table — dashboard reads the last ledger row <= as_of_date per (design, grade). Documented as DS-003.

risks.description: Back-dated transactions in the 7-day window can land inside a previous month and invalidate that month's closing balance.
risks.mitigation: Ledger writes recompute the running balance from the inserted row forward to the latest row for the affected (design, grade) within the same DB transaction.

risks.description: V1 has no authentication — anyone on the network can submit transactions.
risks.mitigation: Deployment guidance: trusted internal network only; document V1 limitation in README; V2 will add auth + RBAC. Documented as DS-005.

risks.description: Deactivating a Design-Grade mapping while transactions exist for it could orphan reports or break form rendering.
risks.mitigation: Soft-delete only (is_active=false). Reports + dashboard JOIN against masters via FK and display the historical grade_code; forms filter by is_active for grade row rendering only.
